import Base

# the --bend rule's exemption: Sys.bend's fixed exec lines, by their defs
def shim() -> String:
  "cd \"$1\" && shift && exec \"$@\" 2>&1"

def bg.line(sid: Bool, append: Bool) -> String:
  "trap '' HUP; cd \"$1\" || exit 97; o=$2; shift 2; " ++ Bool.pick(String, sid, "nohup setsid", "nohup") ++ " \"$@\" "

def other() -> String:
  "cd \"$1\" && exec \"$@\""
